name: Iron

source.quote: Xpeng unveiled Iron, a humanoid robot that stands 178 cm tall and weighs 70 kg, close to a real person.

timeline.detail: XPeng unveiled its first humanoid robot, Iron, at its 2024 AI Day, saying it would work its way into XPeng's own factories.

source.quote: Xpeng unveiled Iron, a humanoid robot that stands 178 cm tall and weighs 70 kg, close to a real person.

timeline.detail: XPeng showed a next-generation Iron walking on stage at 2025 AI Day; the walk looked so human-like that online viewers accused the company of hiding a person inside, prompting CEO He Xiaopeng to cut open the robot's leg on stage to show the wiring.

source.quote: Xpeng's Iron humanoid robot looks so real that some suspect it hides a human inside

notes: Specs recorded here (178 cm / 70 kg / 60+ joints) are for the original Iron unveiled November 2024. The next-generation Iron shown at 2025 AI Day (Nov 5, 2025) has different hand dexterity: CnEVPost's 2025 coverage states 'a hand with 22 degrees of freedom', while a separate report cited elsewhere put per-hand DOF at 21 and total body DOF at 76 for the 2025 version. Updated full-body height/weight for the 2025 generation were not confirmed by a primary or press source during this session, so the 2024 figures are kept as the current record and the hand-DOF conflict is flagged rather than resolved.

No shipped or independently verified customer deployment was found; XPeng has stated mass production is targeted for end of 2026 with deliveries/showroom deployment planned for 2027, which is a plan, not a shipped or demonstrated-in-production status.
